summary: BOXABL Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Product Purchase Agreement with LC Vegas Acquisitions, LLC for up to 1,580 ranch homes over three years, with aggregate potential purchases of ~$233 million. The Buyer is not obligated to purchase and may terminate at any time. An amendment provides equity incentives: $1–$3 million in Class A Common Stock based on deposit size, with resale registration within 120 days after final payment. This is a commercial supply agreement with equity-based incentives, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, tender, or restructuring elements. The filing is routine contract disclosure, so no risk-arb or special-situation dynamics apply.
